Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

survey — a set of questions for many people. Example: I asked ten people in my survey.
opinion — what you think about something. Example: In my opinion the village is better.
problem — something that is wrong. Example: The main problem is noise.
solution — a way to fix a problem. Example: A good solution is to change the time.
agreement — the state of agreeing. Example: There is agreement about the park.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I asked ten people.
• Six agree and four disagree.
• The main problem is ...
• The solution is ...
• Thank you for your answers.
